sections_target.text: Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures

rows: Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
Verify that the siren is working.
Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the water tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
Verify that the water tank is full.
Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
Verify that the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
Verify that the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
Verify that the nozzles for plain water and for multi-purpose use are sound.
Verify that the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
Verify that there are 4 suction connections and the lamp provided with them.
Third: Foam-Liquid Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the foam-liquid tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
Verify that the water tank level is ideal.
Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
Verify that the foam nozzles are sound.
Verify that the foam-liquid level is within the permitted limits.
Fourth: Dry Chemical Powder Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the powder tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
Verify that the powder tank is full.
Verify that the nitrogen cylinders are full (sealing – gauging – weighing).
Verify that the hoses and nozzles (right and left) are sound.
Verify that the gauges are sound.
Fifth: Fire Truck Accessories
Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the daily inspection of the fire-extinguishing systems (water – foam – powder) used on fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mehtadi Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Mohamed Sabri Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of the Nubaria Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures
1. | Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
2. | Verify that the siren is working.
3. | Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the water tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
2. | Verify that the water tank is full.
3. | Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
4. | Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
5. | Verify that the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
6. | Verify that the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
7. | Verify that the nozzles for plain water and for multi-purpose use are sound.
8. | Verify that the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
9. | Verify that there are 4 suction connections and the lamp provided with them.
Third: Foam-Liquid Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the foam-liquid tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
2. | Verify that the water tank level is ideal.
3. | Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
4. | Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
5. | Verify that the foam nozzles are sound.
6. | Verify that the foam-liquid level is within the permitted limits.
Fourth: Dry Chemical Powder Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the powder tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
2. | Verify that the powder tank is full.
3. | Verify that the nitrogen cylinders are full (sealing – gauging – weighing).
4. | Verify that the hoses and nozzles (right and left) are sound.
5. | Verify that the gauges are sound.
Fifth: Fire Truck Accessories
1. | Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
2. | Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
3. | Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
4. | Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.
